scenes.title: How Spotify makes money
scenes.sub: Free users bring the crowd. Premium pays the bills.
scenes.sub_html: Free users bring the crowd. Premium pays the bills.

lines.say: Spotify has seven hundred eighty eight million users.
But most of its money comes from fewer than half of them.
lines.show: But most of its money comes from fewer than half of them.

lines.say: Three hundred six million pay for Premium. That's about thirty nine percent.
lines.show: 306 million pay for Premium. That's about 39%.

lines.say: Those subscribers bring in about ninety percent of revenue. Ads on the free tier bring in about ten.
lines.show: Those subscribers bring in about 90% of revenue. Ads on the free tier bring in about 10%.

lines.say: Each Premium subscriber brought in about fourteen euros sixty six in three months.
lines.show: Each Premium subscriber brought in about €14.66 in three months.

lines.say: Each free user? About ninety seven cents.

scenes.label: after music costs
scenes.note: Costs are mostly royalties. A Q3 record.

lines.say: And Spotify keeps only about thirty three percent, after paying for music rights.
lines.show: And Spotify keeps only about 33%, after paying for music rights.

lines.say: Still, it made six hundred seventy two million euros in operating profit, up fifteen percent.
lines.show: Still, it made €672 million in operating profit, up 15%.

scenes.takeaway: Free brings users. Paid brings profit.
scenes.source: Data: Spotify Q3 2026 results, SEC filing
